AI Engineer Job Summary
The role involves designing intelligent systems, working with large datasets, and collaborating with teams to deliver scalable, high-performance applications. Strong experience in Python, ML frameworks, and problem-solving is essential.
Work Arrangement
Hybrid
Monday - Friday
Noida & Indore
About the Role
We are looking for a passionate and forward-thinking AI Engineer (3+ years) to join our growing team at Invarsys. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy intelligent, data-driven solutions that power next-generation applications.
You will work on machine learning models, AI pipelines, and scalable systems, transforming complex data into impactful business outcomes. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies including ML, deep learning, and GenAI in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.
Key Responsibilities
Design, build, and deploy machine learning & AI models for real-world applications
Develop end-to-end AI systems from data ingestion to model deployment
Work with large datasets, perform data preprocessing, and feature engineering
Build and optimize scalable data pipelines and model training workflows
Integrate AI models into APIs, products, and cloud-based platforms
Monitor model performance, improve accuracy, and ensure continuous optimization
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI-powered business solutions
Implement MLOps practices including deployment, monitoring, and automation
Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI, ML, and Generative AI
What We're Looking For
